misc.sticky_help_body:
Sticky messages stay pinned to the bottom of a channel. I repost them after new messages, including Niko's starboard, level-up, and suggestion posts in their configured channels.

**`{prefix}sticky set <message>`** — create or update the sticky message here
**`{prefix}sticky remove`** — remove the sticky message from this channel
**`{prefix}sticky list`** — list every sticky message in this server
